@@ -27,3 +27,18 @@ test('splitPropertyKey splits nested escaped key with special characters', t =>
   const result = splitPropertyKey('logging\\.domain\\.corp/operation.!\t@#$%^&*()_+=-<>.bar\\.2')
   t.assert.deepStrictEqual(result, ['logging.domain.corp/operation', '!\t@#$%^&*()_+=-<>', 'bar.2'])
 })
+
+test('splitPropertyKey preserves literal backslashes', t => {
+  const result = splitPropertyKey(String.raw`file\path.name`)
+  t.assert.deepStrictEqual(result, [String.raw`file\path`, 'name'])
+})
+
+test('splitPropertyKey supports escaped backslashes', t => {
+  const result = splitPropertyKey(String.raw`file\\path.name`)
+  t.assert.deepStrictEqual(result, [String.raw`file\path`, 'name'])
+})
+
+test('splitPropertyKey preserves a trailing backslash', t => {
+  const result = splitPropertyKey('file\\')
+  t.assert.deepStrictEqual(result, ['file\\'])
+})
